_comment: W16-AO proposals for lane W16-AL. REPORT ONLY -- this lane never wrote scripts/symbol_aliases.json or any icf_alias_* file. Each entry is an ICF fold observed on RETAIL BYTES via the caller channel, not a metric-derived guess. Re-confirm before merging: a fabricated alias lifts name_check BY CONSTRUCTION and the `none` control is structurally blind to it (CLAUDE.md, ALIASAUDIT-1).
_hazard_banner: STLPORT-1: a *size* test cancels a one-sided reader artifact on both sides. Any size-based membership decision must be re-confirmed against the .pdata extent, not against a COMDAT span that may bill the successor symbol's EH funclet prefix.

evidence: 0x8246af50 has exactly TWO retail call sites (tools/retail_callers.py).

Site 1 is inside 0x8246b0e0 = ??$?5VTransform@@V?$StlNodeAlloc@VTransform@@@stlpmtx_std@@@@YAAAVBinStreamRev@@AAV0@AAV?$list@VTransform@@... i.e. operator>>(BinStreamRev&, list<Transform,StlNodeAlloc<Transform> >&).

Two distinct list<T> stream operators calling ONE resize body is the ICF signature: struct RndMultiMesh::Instance has exactly one member, `Transform mXfm` (src/system/rndobj/MultiMesh.h:94-107), so list<Transform>::resize and list<Instance>::resize are byte-identical INCLUDING relocations and fold.

Corroborating node size: the erase chain 0x8246af50 -> 0x824e0e40 (range) -> 0x824e0350 (single) has `li r3, 0x48` before MemOrPoolFreeSTL, i.e. node 72 = sizeof(T) 64 + 8, and sizeof(Transform) == sizeof(Instance) == 64 (Matrix3 48 + Vector3 16).
proposals.why_not_a_map_repair: Both spellings are simultaneously true at this address, so there is no wrong name to repair. W16-AO deliberately LEFT THE MAP ROW ALONE. The remaining value is alias-group membership, which is W16-AL's file.

sibling_addresses_in_the_same_fold_famil.note: erase carries the Transform spelling while insert carries the Instance spelling at the SAME fold family -- the arbitrary-survivor-spelling phenomenon, not a defect.

proposals.distinct_non_folded_control: 0x8241b618 = ?resize@?$list@UInstance@RndMultiMesh@@V?$TransformListAlloc@UInstance@RndMultiMesh@@@... -- the REAL RndMultiMesh::InstanceList instantiation uses TransformListAlloc, is a different COMDAT, and did NOT fold. It is the control showing the StlNodeAlloc-flavoured Instance list is a genuinely separate instantiation.
